faq.a: Zeenat is associated with the Arabic form زِينَة, whose core sense is zeenat; adornment, beauty.

faq.q: What is the origin of Zeenat?
faq.a: Zeenat is associated with Arabic. Zeenat is Arabic زِينَة (Zīna), meaning 'adornment, beauty'.
Yes — the underlying form زِينَة is Arabic.
Zeenat can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Zeenat should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Zīna is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Zeenat mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Zeenat is rendered زینت and carries the sense زینت، آرائش.

faq.q: What does Zeenat mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Zeenat is rendered زینت and carries the sense زینت، زیبایی.
A romanized syllable approximation is zee-nat. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Zeenat?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Zeenat, zeenat. Script forms are زينت, زِينَة, زینت, ज़ीनत.

faq.q: Is Zeenat a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
